justification: WO-4 + WO-5 — the two residual key-null bugs from the adversarial audit (Part A), both single display fields. WO-4: conveyancing_db.fetch_nearby_das SELECTed cost_of_development and unpacked it as `cost` but omitted it from the returned dict, so the brief's NearbyDA.cost (read via d.get('cost_of_development')) was always null; added it to the dict. WO-5: ShadowScenario carried sun_altitude_deg/sun_azimuth_deg which the shadow service never emits (it emits shadow_direction_deg = opposite of sun azimuth) and nothing renders — always-null dead fields; removed them from the model and the brief mapping. The real shadow-direction datum is retained.

pre_impl.existing_data: fetch_nearby_das row unpacks cost (10th column) but the appended dict omitted it. ShadowScenario.sun_altitude_deg/sun_azimuth_deg used only by the model decl + the brief mapping + one self-confirming test fixture; the shadow service emits neither.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed the brief mapping was wrong for DA cost; in fact the brief reads the right key — the DB helper dropped it. For shadow, the fields were dead (never produced) not mis-mapped.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: WO-4 adds one key to an existing dict. WO-5 removes two dead fields. No new mechanism.
pre_impl.external_source_error: N/A — DB row already carried cost; shadow fields were never sourced.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Backend only; the frontend ShadowData interface never referenced the sun fields, so no UI change.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: nearby-DA cost always blank; two always-null sun fields on the model. After: DA cost surfaces when present; the dead fields are gone (no field reading a key that isn't produced).

functions.name: fetch_nearby_das
functions.input: a db connection, lat, lng, optional council, radius and lookback days
functions.output: nearby DA dicts that now include cost_of_development from the row
functions.if_none: a row with a null cost yields cost_of_development None, which the brief renders as no-cost-recorded

values: N/A - DA cost is factual API/DB output, not a regulatory value.
queries: N/A - the SELECT already fetched cost_of_development; only the returned dict changed (no query change).

break_it.scenario: A DA row has a null cost_of_development
break_it.what_happens: cost should be None, not fabricated
break_it.how: the value is passed through as-is; None stays None

break_it.scenario: A consumer still reads ShadowScenario.sun_altitude_deg after removal
break_it.how: verified the only references were the model decl, the brief mapping, and a test fixture's extra keys (ignored); the frontend never read them

break_it.scenario: fetch_nearby_das output shape relied on by another caller breaks
break_it.what_happens: adding a key could surprise a strict consumer
break_it.how: adding a key is additive; the brief and conveyancing report read by name, so an extra key is ignored by existing consumers

post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief with nearby DAs that have a cost — the cost now appears. Shadow card renders unchanged (the removed fields were never shown).
